sample_sentences.ko_text: 간호사를 대상으로 한 시범 조사를 통해 언어 표현 문제, 이해도, 설문지 작성에 소요되는 시간 등을 조사하였다.
sample_sentences.en_text: A pilot survey was conducted among nurses to examine problems of language expressions, the degree of comprehension and time needed to complete the questionnaire.

sample_sentences.en_text: The new nurse found me changing positively over time.
